all_partitions: same orthogonal formula evaluated with each exact xq,xg

representative.coordinate: S=sqrt(xq) sq+sqrt(xg) sg; srel=sqrt(xg) sq-sqrt(xq) sg
representative.forward: Q=sqrt(xq) qq+sqrt(xg) qg; qrel=sqrt(xg) qq-sqrt(xq) qg
representative.inverse: qq=sqrt(xq) Q+sqrt(xg) qrel; qg=sqrt(xg) Q-sqrt(xq) qrel
representative.jacobian: det= -1 per transverse Cartesian direction; absolute Jacobian=1

units: q GeV; s GeV^-1; Q/qrel GeV; S/srel GeV^-1
